entries.title: Old app compatibility
entries.text: If an app built for an Android version before 4.0 crashes, turn on Old app compatibility for it. Android then runs that app more like older versions did.

entries.title: Fixes and improvements
points: Fixed the camera preview freezing after you take a photo
Fixed the camera preview lagging behind in video mode
A camera recording now ends and is saved when you leave Andarium
Fixed the start of a video recording having no sound
Fixed 3D graphics failing to start in apps that run PC programs

entries.title: Snapshots
entries.text: Save the virtual machine’s data and restore it later, from Home.

entries.title: Resolution
entries.text: On Home, choose the resolution of the virtual machine’s display, up to your screen’s native resolution.

entries.title: Rotation on iPad
entries.text: On iPad, the whole app now turns with the device, even while the virtual machine runs.

entries.title: Keyboard, mouse and controllers
entries.text: Use a hardware keyboard and game controllers with the virtual machine, and on iPad a mouse or trackpad too.

entries.title: Location
entries.text: Share this device’s location with the virtual machine. It is off until you turn it on in Capabilities on Home.

entries.title: Camera
entries.text: Use this device’s cameras in the virtual machine. It is off until you turn it on in Capabilities on Home.

entries.title: Haptics
entries.text: On iPhone, the virtual machine’s vibration now plays on the Taptic Engine. You can turn it off in Capabilities on Home.

entries.title: Install older Android apps
entries.text: Use Install APK to install an app built for a much older version of Android. Andarium warns you first that the app may not work properly.

entries.title: Send feedback
entries.text: Email the developer from the Info menu on Home, or from Settings while the virtual machine runs, with screenshots and a bug report if you like.

entries.title: More fixes
points: Fixed the virtual machine not starting with more than 4 GiB of RAM
Fixed Andarium quitting when installing a very large APK
Fixed the virtual machine’s Wi-Fi not reconnecting after it drops
Fixed a crash when a network connection closes suddenly
Fixed more crashes in 3D games and apps
Fixed apps installed with Install APK not appearing on Android’s home screen

entries.title: File browser
entries.text: Browse the virtual machine’s internal storage, and import or export files and folders.

entries.title: More memory
entries.text: On devices that allow it, the virtual machine’s RAM can now go above 4 GiB.

entries.title: Stability fixes
points: Fixed the virtual machine crashing on many iPhones
Fixed a crash when returning to Andarium from the background
Fixed crashes in some 3D games and apps
Fixed a crash when using the gyroscope
Fixed high CPU use and heat after a network connection drops
Reduced stutters and sound dropouts under load
